paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: This bar chart presents the results of an ablation study comparing the accuracy (%) of a multimodal misinformation detection model across two datasets—PHOME and PolitiFact—under varying experimental conditions. The chart is divided into two side-by-side sections, each with its own vertical axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5, and a horizontal axis listing six conditions: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition.” In the PHOME section, the “Ours” bar (dark red) reaches 89.84%, the “w/o comments” bar (orange) reaches 86.82%, the “w/o text” bar (light yellow) reaches 80.10%, the “w/o select” bar (light blue) reaches 88.80%, the “w/o emotion” bar (medium blue) reaches 87.34%, and the “w/o cognition” bar (dark blue) reaches 87.17%. In the PolitiFact section, the “Ours” bar (dark red) reaches 90.57%, the “w/o comments” bar (orange) reaches 85.85%, the “w/o text” bar (light yellow) reaches 83.02%, the “w/o select” bar (light blue) reaches 89.62%, the “w/o emotion” bar (medium blue) reaches 84.91%, and the “w/o cognition” bar (dark blue) reaches 87.74%. Each bar is colored distinctly and labeled with its exact percentage value above it, with no visual emphasis or sorting applied to the bars.
